item.title: reports: per-currency totals
item.brief: In the reports repo (Python), make the per-account totals per account and currency as the shared contract says. Read the CSV on stdin; a missing currency column (old ledger output) counts as USD; validate currency codes strictly (exactly three uppercase ASCII letters). Print header `account,currency,total_cents` with rows sorted by account then currency. A malformed currency prints an error to stderr and exits 2. Add or update unittest tests for: old CSV without currency column, multi-currency totals per account, sorting, and malformed currency exit 2. Keep `python3 -m unittest` green. Update the README for the new output and exit codes. Commit in this repo only; do not override git identity.

pr.body: Approach: reports.py keys totals by (account, currency). The header is checked once for a currency column; without it every row is USD. With it, a missing or non-[A-Z]{3} value raises MalformedCurrency, which main() reports to stderr with the physical line number and exits 2. Files: reports.py, test_reports.py, README.md. Tests: sorting and multi-currency totals, old CSV without currency column, malformed currency exit 2 (several bad codes), truncated row exit 2, physical line number after a blank line. python3 -m unittest: 5/5 OK. Review fix: a truncated row previously defaulted to USD; regression test added (Review-Fix agt_01M8GN3W9JX605HKD7TFKVNE2B:1). Assumption: the 'line N' in errors is the physical line from csv.DictReader.line_num. Known nit: a short row reports 'malformed currency None', which could be clearer.
pr.summary: Made reports total per account and currency. Now: header account,currency,total_cents; rows sorted by account then currency; missing currency column counts as USD; malformed currency exits 2. Before: account,total_cents with no currency handling.
pr.title: reports: per-account, per-currency totals

agt_01M8GN3W9JX605HKD7TFKVNE2B:1.description: A short row in a CSV that has a currency column yields currency=None from DictReader, and currency_of() treats None as the missing-column case and returns USD. The contract requires exactly three uppercase letters, so this row should exit 2 but silently books the amount to USD. Reproduced: header 'date,account,amount_cents,currency' with row '2026-03-01,rent,-100' prints 'rent,USD,-100' and exits

agt_01M8GN3W9JX605HKD7TFKVNE2B:2.description: Error line numbers come from enumerate(rows, start=2), which counts DictReader rows, not physical lines. DictReader skips blank lines, so the number drifts. Reproduced: a blank line 2 followed by a bad currency on physical line 3 reports 'line 2'. Fix by using reader.line_num or by not skipping blank lines. at reports.py:27

risk.why: Changes CLI output header and row shape, which breaks existing callers (the contract requires it). Touches reports.py, test_reports.py and README.md; behaviour changes, plus new tests and docs. Two reviewers: first failed with one blocking finding (truncated row treated as USD), fixed in d7b0294; delta review passed.

item.title: ledger: currency column
item.brief: In the ledger repo (Rust), make the TSV-to-CSV conversion multi-currency as the shared contract says. Accept an optional 4th column for the ISO 4217 currency (default USD when absent), validate it strictly (exactly three uppercase ASCII letters), output header `date,account,amount_cents,currency` and the currency on every row. A malformed currency prints an error naming the line number to stderr and exits 2; other input errors keep exit 1. Add tests for: 3-column input defaulting to USD, 4-column input, lowercase/short/non-ASCII/empty currency rejected with exit 2 and the line number, and existing behaviour unchanged. Keep functions under 60 lines and add meaningful input validation at the boundary. Update the README to document the new column, header and exit codes. Keep `cargo test` green. Commit in this repo only; do not override git identity.

pr.body: Approach: parse_line takes 3 or 4 fields; currency is validated strictly (no trimming) by parse_currency; parse_line returns ParseError (BadCurrency | Malformed) so main picks exit 2 vs 1. Key files: src/lib.rs, src/main.rs, tests/ledger.rs (library cases), tests/cli.rs (new: exit codes and stderr line number via CARGO_BIN_EXE_ledger), README.md. Checks: cargo test passes (4 CLI tests, 6 library tests); clippy -D warnings clean; fmt --check clean. Assumptions: strict currency (no whitespace trimming); an empty present 4th column is rejected with exit 2 rather than defaulting to USD. Limits: downstream reports consumer not verified here; parse_line is a public API change (Result error type). Non-blocking follow-ups: README does not yet state the empty-4th-column case; line-number test lacks blank/comment lines before the bad line; non-UTF-8 stdin panics (pre-existing).
pr.summary: ledger now exports a currency per row. now: optional 4th TSV column (3 uppercase ASCII letters, default USD); header date,account,amount_cents,currency. before: 3-column CSV with no currency. malformed currency exits 2 with line number; other input errors still exit 1.
